dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Deeply concave trailing edge with a high-curvature spline extending from the posterior dorsal ridge to the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded apex with an obtuse pixel radius classification.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Steep anterior margin contour, approximately 65 degrees relative to the horizontal body axis.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Moderate convexity visible on the dorsal-anterior margin, partially obscured by high-intensity specular bloom.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, robust rostrum with a pixel length approximately 1.5 times its thickness at the base.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Measurable obtuse interior angle of approximately 145 degrees at the transition point from the melon to the rostrum.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced polygonal faceting on ventral and posterior margins and extreme overexposure/specular glare on the dorsal-lateral surface.
